findings.issue: VERSION read by qmake cat() was not tracked, and a changed compiler definition did not rebuild main.o
findings.fix: Track VERSION as a qmake input and generate a header included by all three version consumers.

findings.issue: Windows deployment validated numeric PE ProductVersion only, accepting different prerelease suffixes
findings.fix: Run the deployed executable with redirected --version output and compare the exact full version before every material mode. Reject mismatch, empty output, nonzero exit, launch failure and timeout.

findings.issue: Documentation review metadata linked a UI report instead of a documentation audit
findings.fix: Reference this scoped audit separately; preserve historical UI evidence.
